---
title: "Get Scores: ARF, CALF and RT control"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script:

1. Computes each student's score on each task (ARF FR, ARF FC, CALF FR, CALF FC) and RT control block (FR, 2AFC, 6AFC).
2. Computes each student's median log RT, number correct, number attempted and accuracy (number correct / number attempted).
3. Computes the split-half scores for reliability: the even and odd 15-second interval scores of each task, and the first and second half scores of each RT control block.
4. Computes the RT control residuals: the residual of each task score after regressing it on the matching RT control score (FR control for the FR tasks, 2AFC control for ARF FC, 6AFC control for CALF FC). Also computes the grade residuals of the even and odd split-half scores (after regressing them on grade), for the overall reliability partialing out grade.
5. Adds the device each student used.
6. Saves three versions of the scores, used by the analyses:
   - `scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv`
   - `scores_combined_rtFiltered.csv`
   - `scores_combined_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv`
7. For the no cleaning and fully cleaned versions, also saves the scores joined with the scores of the other apps (SWR, SRE, PA and ALPACA):
   - `scores_all_apps_no_cleaning.csv`
   - `scores_all_apps_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv`

# Scoring functions

## RT control scores

```{r}
getRtScore<-function(rt_block){
  rt_block %>%
    mutate(log_rt=log(rt)) %>%
    group_by(ID,user_grade_at_run,meta_data.corpus_name) %>%
    summarise(median_log_rt=median(log_rt),
              rt_correct=sum(correct),
              rt_incorrect=n()-rt_correct,
              rtControl_num_attempted = n(),
              ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(rtControl_score = case_when(meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_2afc"~ rt_correct-rt_incorrect,
                                meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_6afc"~ rt_correct-(0.2*rt_incorrect),
                                meta_data.corpus_name=="rtControl_production" ~rt_correct
                                ),
           rtControl_accuracy = rt_correct/rtControl_num_attempted,
           rtControl_num_correct = rt_correct) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(rt_correct,rt_incorrect)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = meta_data.corpus_name, values_from = c(median_log_rt,rtControl_score,rtControl_accuracy,rtControl_num_correct,rtControl_num_attempted)) %>%
    rename(rtControl_rt_2afc="median_log_rt_rtControl_2afc",
           rtControl_rt_6afc="median_log_rt_rtControl_6afc",
           rtControl_rt_production="median_log_rt_rtControl_production",
           rtControl_score_2afc="rtControl_score_rtControl_2afc",
           rtControl_score_6afc="rtControl_score_rtControl_6afc",
           rtControl_score_production="rtControl_score_rtControl_production",
           rtControl_num_correct_2afc="rtControl_num_correct_rtControl_2afc",
           rtControl_num_correct_6afc="rtControl_num_correct_rtControl_6afc",
           rtControl_num_correct_production="rtControl_num_correct_rtControl_production",
           rtControl_num_attempted_2afc="rtControl_num_attempted_rtControl_2afc",
           rtControl_num_attempted_6afc="rtControl_num_attempted_rtControl_6afc",
           rtControl_num_attempted_production="rtControl_num_attempted_rtControl_production",
           rtControl_accuracy_2afc="rtControl_accuracy_rtControl_2afc",
           rtControl_accuracy_6afc="rtControl_accuracy_rtControl_6afc",
           rtControl_accuracy_production="rtControl_accuracy_rtControl_production"
           )
}
```

## ARF and CALF scores

```{r}
getTaskScore<-function(data, modality, task_name){
  data %>%
    mutate(log_rt=log(rt)) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    mutate(median_log_rt=median(log_rt),
           num_attempted = .data[[paste0("scores.computed.", modality, ".numAttempted")]],
           num_correct = .data[[paste0("scores.computed.", modality, ".numCorrect")]],
           accuracy = num_correct/num_attempted,
           score = .data[[paste0("scores.computed.", modality, ".rawScore")]]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(ID,user_grade_at_run) %>%
    reframe(!!task_name := score,
            !!paste0("rt_", task_name) := median_log_rt,
            !!paste0("num_correct_", task_name) := num_correct,
            !!paste0("num_attempted_", task_name) := num_attempted,
            !!paste0("accuracy_", task_name) := accuracy) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(ID,user_grade_at_run), names_to = "task", values_to = "score") %>%
    mutate(user_grade_at_run = as.character(user_grade_at_run))
}

getScoresMath<-function(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,rt_block){
  sub_data<-bind_rows(getTaskScore(arf_production, "FR", "arf_prod"),
                      getTaskScore(arf_2afc, "FC", "arf_2afc"),
                      getTaskScore(calf_production, "FR", "calf_prod"),
                      getTaskScore(calf_6afc, "FC", "calf_6afc")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "task", values_from = "score")

  full_join(sub_data, getRtScore(rt_block), by=c("ID", "user_grade_at_run"))
}
```

## Arithmetic tasks split-half scores

```{r}
even_odd_interval<-function(data, modality, task_name){
  data_intervals<-data %>%
    dplyr::select(ID,time_elapsed,trial_num_block,meta_data.corpus_name,rt,correct) %>%
    group_by(ID,meta_data.corpus_name) %>%
    arrange(ID, meta_data.corpus_name, trial_num_block) %>%
    mutate(start_time_task=time_elapsed[which.min(trial_num_block)]-rt[which.min(trial_num_block)]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(time_from_start=time_elapsed-start_time_task,
           interval_num=floor(time_from_start/15000)+1) %>%
    group_by(ID,interval_num, meta_data.corpus_name) %>%
    summarise(total_correct=sum(correct, na.rm=TRUE),
              total_incorrect=as.numeric(sum(correct == 0, na.rm=TRUE)),
              .groups = "keep") %>%
    mutate(score= switch(modality,
      "production" = total_correct,
      "2afc" = total_correct - total_incorrect,
      "6afc" = total_correct - (0.2*total_incorrect))) %>%
    mutate(score = replace_na(score, 0),
           total_correct = replace_na(total_correct, 0),
           order=ifelse(interval_num%%2, "odd", "even")) %>%
    ungroup()

  data_intervals %>%
    group_by(ID, order) %>%
    summarise(overall_score=sum(score),
              overall_correct=sum(total_correct),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = order, values_from = c(overall_score, overall_correct)) %>%
    transmute(ID,
              even=replace_na(overall_score_even, 0),
              odd=replace_na(overall_score_odd, 0),
              even_correct=replace_na(overall_correct_even, 0),
              odd_correct=replace_na(overall_correct_odd, 0)) %>%
    arrange(ID) %>%
    mutate(task=task_name)
}

# Adds the even/odd scores and number correct for all four tasks
getEvenOddScore<-function(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,sub_data){
  scores_even_odd<-rbind(even_odd_interval(arf_production, "production", "arf_prod"),
                         even_odd_interval(arf_2afc, "2afc", "arf_2afc"),
                         even_odd_interval(calf_6afc, "6afc", "calf_6afc"),
                         even_odd_interval(calf_production, "production", "calf_prod")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "task", values_from = c("even", "odd", "even_correct", "odd_correct"))

  left_join(sub_data, scores_even_odd, by=c("ID"))
}
```

## RT control split-half scores

```{r}
getRtHalfScore<-function(rt_block, sub_data){
  rt_halves<-rt_block %>%
    group_by(ID, meta_data.corpus_name) %>%
    arrange(trial_num_block, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(start_time_task=time_elapsed[which.min(trial_num_block)]-rt[which.min(trial_num_block)],
           mid_time=(time_elapsed[which.max(trial_num_block)]-start_time_task)/2+start_time_task,
           half=ifelse(time_elapsed<=mid_time, "first", "second")) %>%
    group_by(ID, meta_data.corpus_name, half) %>%
    summarise(total_correct=sum(correct, na.rm=TRUE),
              total_incorrect=sum(correct == 0, na.rm=TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(block=sub("^rtControl_", "", meta_data.corpus_name),
           score=case_when(block == "production" ~ total_correct,
                           block == "2afc" ~ total_correct - total_incorrect,
                           block == "6afc" ~ total_correct - (0.2*total_incorrect))) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, block, half, score) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = half, values_from = score) %>%
    mutate(first=replace_na(first, 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = block, values_from = c(first, second),
                names_glue = "rtControl_{.value}_{block}")

  left_join(sub_data, rt_halves, by=c("ID"))
}
```

## RT control residuals

```{r}
calculateResid <- function(sub_data, math_var, control_var) {
  math_var <- enquo(math_var)
  control_var <- enquo(control_var)
  newvar <- paste0("resid_score_", quo_name(math_var))

  df <- sub_data %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, !!math_var, !!control_var, user_grade_at_run) %>%
    drop_na()

  form <- as.formula(paste0(quo_name(math_var), " ~ ", quo_name(control_var)))

  df %>%
    mutate(!!newvar := resid(lm(form, data = df))) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, user_grade_at_run, !!sym(newvar))
}

# Residuals for the four task scores and their even/odd split-half scores
getResidualScore<-function(sub_data){
  all_resid <- reduce(list(calculateResid(sub_data, arf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, arf_2afc, rtControl_score_2afc),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, calf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, calf_6afc, rtControl_score_6afc),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, even_arf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, odd_arf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, even_arf_2afc, rtControl_score_2afc),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, odd_arf_2afc, rtControl_score_2afc),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, even_calf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, odd_calf_prod, rtControl_score_production),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, even_calf_6afc, rtControl_score_6afc),
                           calculateResid(sub_data, odd_calf_6afc, rtControl_score_6afc)),
                      full_join,
                      by = c("ID", "user_grade_at_run"))

  sub_data %>%
    full_join(all_resid, by=c("ID", "user_grade_at_run"))
}
```

## Grade residuals of the split-half scores

```{r}
getGradeResidualScore<-function(sub_data){
  sub_data<-sub_data %>%
    mutate(grade_as_int=as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0",
                                             .default = as.character(user_grade_at_run))))

  for (task in c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc")) {
    halves<-c(paste0("even_", task), paste0("odd_", task))
    keep<-complete.cases(sub_data[, c(task, halves, "grade_as_int")])
    for (half in halves) {
      sub_data[[paste0("grade_resid_", half)]]<-NA_real_
      sub_data[[paste0("grade_resid_", half)]][keep]<-resid(lm(sub_data[[half]][keep] ~ sub_data$grade_as_int[keep]))
    }
  }

  sub_data %>%
    dplyr::select(-grade_as_int)
}
```

## Combine everything

```{r}
# Number of students with data for each task, and with data for all tasks
getTaskCounts<-function(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,rt_block){
  has_task<-rbind(arf_production %>% distinct(ID) %>% mutate(task="ARF_FR"),
                  arf_2afc %>% distinct(ID) %>% mutate(task="ARF_FC"),
                  calf_production %>% distinct(ID) %>% mutate(task="CALF_FR"),
                  calf_6afc %>% distinct(ID) %>% mutate(task="CALF_FC"),
                  rt_block %>% distinct(ID,meta_data.corpus_name) %>% rename(task=meta_data.corpus_name)) %>%
    mutate(hasScore = 1)

  print(has_task %>% count(task, name = "count"))
  print(has_task %>% pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = hasScore) %>% drop_na())
}

# Reads the five data files, computes all the scores, adds the device, prints the counts, and writes the scores file.
# Writes the scores joined with the scores of the other apps.
getScores<-function(rt_file, arf_prod_file, arf_2afc_file, calf_prod_file, calf_6afc_file, out_file, all_apps_file = NULL, remove_calf_k1 = FALSE){
  read_trials<-function(f) read.csv(paste0(savepath, "cleaning_arf_calf/", f))

  rt_block<-read_trials(rt_file)
  arf_production<-read_trials(arf_prod_file)
  arf_2afc<-read_trials(arf_2afc_file)
  calf_production<-read_trials(calf_prod_file)
  calf_6afc<-read_trials(calf_6afc_file)
  
  if (remove_calf_k1) {
    calf_production<-calf_production %>% filter(!(user_grade_at_run %in% c("Kindergarten", "1")))
    calf_6afc<-calf_6afc %>% filter(!(user_grade_at_run %in% c("Kindergarten", "1")))
  }

  getTaskCounts(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,rt_block)

  scores_combined<-getScoresMath(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,rt_block)
  scores_combined<-getEvenOddScore(arf_production,arf_2afc,calf_production,calf_6afc,scores_combined)
  scores_combined<-getRtHalfScore(rt_block,scores_combined)
  scores_combined<-left_join(scores_combined,device_type,by="ID")
  scores_combined<-getResidualScore(scores_combined)
  scores_combined<-getGradeResidualScore(scores_combined)

  print(scores_combined %>% count(user_grade_at_run))
  print(scores_combined %>% count(device) %>% mutate(total = sum(n), percent = round(n/total, 2)))

  write.csv(scores_combined,paste0(savepath,"scores/", out_file), row.names = FALSE)

  if (!is.null(all_apps_file)) {
    scores_all_apps<-full_join(scores_combined, other_apps_scores, by="ID")
    write.csv(scores_all_apps,paste0(savepath,"scores/", all_apps_file), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  scores_combined
}
```

# Compute the scores

```{r}
# Complete data without any participant exclusion
scores_no_cleaning<-getScores("rt-block.csv", "arf-production.csv", "arf-2afc.csv", "calf-production.csv", "calf-6afc.csv",
                              "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv", all_apps_file = "scores_all_apps_no_cleaning.csv",
                              remove_calf_k1 = TRUE)
```
